source_scope: Known proof delivery is not answer correctness. Insufficiency, ambiguity and qualified source judgments remain distinct from native reference metrics.
cost_scope: Actual receipts charged once. Standalone methods include each within-arm unique Reader response and all controller prefix work, including reused work. Dense encoding, common retrieval and local loads/preparation are separate. Tokenizers differ; tokens are not equivalent FLOPs. Warm component sums are not measured standalone production latency. Review cost not fully metered.
semantic_review_scope: Conditional source-contract outcomes under recorded source/response interpretations. Correct Reader abstention on a deficient selected subset is not task success when a source-supported answer exists in the full pool. Masked cases and qualified responses are retained separately. Native metrics and first outputs are unchanged; not universal or independent-gold accuracy.
